Memorandumof Sublease Pursuant to Section 291-C of The New York Real Property Law 26, Date of Sublease: As of October'2001 (the "Sublease") Name and Address of Landlord: S&M Enterprises LLC 429East 52nd Street New York, New York 10022 Name and Address of Tenants: Jay Harper and Diana Gordon 150 East 37th Street New York, New York  10016 Description of Demised Premises: Apartment No. 9A 150East 37th Street New York, New York 10016 Block 892 Lot 1054 Term of Sublease: Commencing April 17， 2002 and to continue for seventy-five years or the life of the Tenant, whichever is less, subject to the limitations contained in the Sublease. Extension Options: None. The Tenant's right to occupy the unit can only be terminated by the expiration of the Sublease, the death of the Tenant, his/her surrender of the unit, or the grounds for termination stated in the Sublease. The Sublease cannot be extinguished or affected by any change in ownership of， or encumbrance on, the unit， and is not subject to extinction or modification through any statutory provisions for the benefit of any owner or lienor， including but not limited to current or future statutory provisions for the extinction of leases in the course of foreclosure, redemption or bankruptcy proceedings.

Encumbrances: The Premises isto be free of all encumbrances other than mortgages and the mortgagees have entered into subordination and non-disturbance agreements.  THE TERM GRANTED TO THE TENANT UNDER THE SUBLEASE IS SUPERIOR TO ALLEXISTING AND SUBSEQUENTLIENSTHAT MAY ATTACH TO THE APARTMENT,AND IS CONSENTED TO BY THE UNIT OWNER，PBW. Other Provisions: For so long as the Apartment is occupied by the Tenant, S&M Enterprises LLC or its successors or assigns, shall pay insurance(in an amount equal to the full value of the Apartment). S&M Enterprises LLC shall yearly exhibit proof of such insurance payments to the Tenant and shall pay for the painting and operating expenses relating to the Apartment. Memorandum of_Sublease: Thisinstrumentisintended to be andis entered intoas a memorandum of the Sublease for the purpose of recordation and the giving of notice of the tenancy created by the Sublease and of the rights and obligations of Landlord and Tenant thereunder, and shall not, in any event, be construed to change, vary, modify or interpret the Sublease or any of the terms， covenants or conditions thereof, or any part thereof, which are set forth, described or summarized herein and reference is hereby made to the Sublease for any and all purposes. All of the terms, covenants and conditions contained in the Sublease are hereby incorporated herein by reference with like effect as if set forth herein verbatim. IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this Memorandum of Agreement as of this dayof November，2ool.
